Bite. Melee Weapon The hunger briefly teleports to its chosen location. Attack: +14 to hit, reach 60 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) piercing damage, and the target is swallowed if it is a Medium or smaller creature. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the hunger, and takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the hunger’s  turns.If the The Hunger takes 45 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, it must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the The Hunger. If the The Hunger dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 10 feet of movement, exiting prone. After the action is complete it teleports back to its original location.

Solomon flies straight toward the creature emerging from the hunger. Arcane words ring in the air as he casts power word stun on the abomination. The creatures instantly ceases all movement. Solomon leaps off his flying mount and lands on the head of the creature. He turns to the combatants and cries,

“I will tear the power from this creature and ascend to the heavens! Behold the birth of a god!”

No sooner does he finish his short monologue than a pair of black portals appear above Croatoan as its chains begin to glow with hellfire. Inky black tentacles grab Solomon and slam him to the ground. It was a ruse! It is not affected by the power word stun spell. It whips him around and slams him into the ground. Solomon lays in the mud in a bloody heap, unmoving. The creature turns his attention away from the pitiful form on the ground to more succulent prey.
